ingredients: 1 rack pork loin back ribs (baby back)
1 cup barbecue sauce, plus more for brushing
directions: Remove the membrane from the back of the rack of ribs.
Season both sides of the ribs with the rub.
Cut between bones to separate into 4 portions to fit in a pressure cooker.
Place ribs in pressure cooker with root beer. Lock lid and cook on high pressure (Beef/Pork setting) for 30 minutes.
Let steam release naturally for 10 minutes, then manually release remaining pressure.
Remove ribs, brush with barbecue sauce, and broil in the oven on high for 3–5 minutes until slightly crisped.
Pour barbecue sauce into the pot with the remaining juices. Bring to a boil and cook uncovered for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. Serve alongside ribs.
